heading: Tuesday, July 1, 2025
topLine: Zhipu AI releases GLM-4.1V-Thinking vision reasoning model.

items.headline: Zhipu AI releases GLM-4.1V-Thinking vision reasoning model
items.summary: GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking is an open-weight 9B vision-language model trained with reinforcement learning for multimodal reasoning, released with a technical report. It is the first model in the GLM-V line that later produced GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.6V.
